svg.title: One invoke, two model calls, one tool call
svg.desc: An isometric drawing of one create_agent run in one Python process. Above, on a LangChain layer, sit your code as a violet terminal, the chat model as a plum tower, and the tool add as a green unit. Below, the CompiledStateGraph from create_agent is an indigo shell with the LangGraph mark. It holds the model and tools nodes and the messages channel, drawn as four sheets. Your code calls invoke with What is 2 + 3? Model call 1 returns an AIMessage with the tool call add(a=2, b=3). The tools node runs add and returns a ToolMessage of 5. Model call 2 returns The sum is 5. The graph puts 5 checkpoints in InMemorySaver, steps -1 to 3, and the last has no next node. Off to the right, LangSmith is a dashed tower that gets 7 runs only when tracing is on. On the Mac, Apple M1 Max, create_agent took 7.67 ms per run against 4.10 ms for a plain openai loop.
svg.text: ONE AGENT RUN · LANGCHAIN 1.5.0 · LANGGRAPH 1.2.22 · PYTHON 3.13
MEASURED ON THE MAC · APPLE M1 MAX
create_agent 7.67 ms per run, plain openai loop 4.10 ms
+3.57 ms per run; with InMemorySaver 8.94 ms
medians of 200 runs each, stub model, three model calls per run
